topic: Maxing the 401k match vs leaving it on the table (Eli vs Hannah)

scenes.narration: Skipping a four percent employer match is leaving twenty thousand dollars on the table over five years. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard labeled FREE MONEY MATCH, comic burst banner reads TWENTY THOUSAND ON THE TABLE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eli and Hannah both work for the same company that matches four percent into the 401k and both make seventy five thousand dollars a year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, left side man eli at the doctor's desk with a benefits packet, right side woman hannah at the desk with the same packet, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eli skipped the 401k enrollment form because he wanted every dollar in his paycheck right now and felt overwhelmed by the choices.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man eli on a couch tossing a benefits packet aside, comic banner reads SKIPPED THE FORM, an empty 401k icon, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hannah signed up the first day, contributed four percent, captured the full employer match, and chose a low cost target date fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman hannah at a kitchen table signing a 401k form, a small icon labeled MATCH FOUR PERCENT highlighted in green, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Five years later Eli still has zero in his 401k. He missed twenty thousand dollars in employer money and any growth on top.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked man eli staring at an empty 401k balance on a phone, comic banner reads ZERO MATCH ZERO GROWTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hannah's 401k has forty thousand dollars and growing. Half came from her, half came from her employer and the market.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side eli with empty hands, right side hannah with a brokerage app reading FORTY THOUSAND with a target date fund label, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Always capture the full employer match before any other investing. It is a one hundred percent return on day one. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
